positive.description: A strumming pattern over a chord progression, named directly.
positive.prompt: Make me a Guitar Pal strumming pattern for C G Am F at 90 bpm.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls propose_strum once with a one-bar 4/4 rhythm such as "D DU UD ", chords C, G, Am, F and bpm 90. Replies with the returned guitarpal.sloanwan.com/p/<id> link, which opens a player with four bars, one chord each, at 90 bpm.

positive.description: A fingerpicking exercise described by what the player wants to hear, without naming the plugin.
positive.prompt: Write me an easy Travis-picking exercise in C and let me listen to how it should sound.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls propose_tab with a few bars in 4/4 on an 8-slot grid: an alternating thumb on strings 4–6 and melody notes on strings 1–3 over C-family chords. Replies with the /p/<id> link; the page plays the exercise and shows it as tab.

positive.description: A tab image brought into the player. The attached image is an original exercise rendered by Guitar Pal.
positive.prompt: Bring this tab into Guitar Pal so I can play it back.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the attached tab and calls import_tab with its bars, copying every fret and the printed note values. Replies with the /p/<id> link; any places it was unsure of are listed under the title on the page.

positive.description: A riff with techniques, composed and made playable.
positive.prompt: Compose a short blues lick in A with a couple of hammer-ons that I can loop slowly while I practise.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls propose_tab with a short lick in A whose notes carry hammer links. Replies with the /p/<id> link; the player loops the lick and the hammer-ons are drawn and played.

positive.description: A request in Chinese for a strumming pattern with a capo.
positive.prompt: 用 Guitar Pal 给我一个 G Em C D 的民谣扫弦，变调夹夹 2 品，100 拍。
positive.expected_behavior: Calls propose_strum with a 4/4 folk rhythm, chords G, Em, C, D, bpm 100 and capo 2. Replies (in Chinese) with the /p/<id> link; the player shows capo 2 and four bars at 100 bpm.

negative.description: Music theory question: the plugin should not act. Expected: answered in words, no tool call and no link.
negative.prompt: Why does a capo change the key but not the chord shapes?

negative.description: Technique advice: nothing to play, so the plugin should not act. Expected: practical advice in words, no tool call.
negative.prompt: How do I stop my F barre chord from buzzing?

negative.description: Gear recommendation outside the plugin's scope. Expected: a normal answer, no tool call.
negative.prompt: What's a good acoustic guitar for a beginner under $300?
